concept: Swiss Corporate Precision. A highly functional, trust-inspiring command center for UAE compliance and audit workflows. Focuses on information clarity, objective data presentation, and rigid grid structures.

layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8 (Generous internal padding for forms and cards)
layout_and_spacing.corners: rounded-md (max 8px) for containers, rounded-sm for inputs
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200). Avoid soft, heavy shadows to maintain a strict, objective corporate feel.

components_strategy.framework: React (.js) with Tailwind CSS and heavily customized Shadcn UI primitives

icons.style: Duotone or regular weight, matching text color unless indicating status

components_strategy.kpi_cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px border (border-slate-200). On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), shadow-sm, border darkens to border-slate-300.
components_strategy.ai_assistant: Dockable/Contextual side panel. Use a strict 1px vertical border to separate from main content. AI chat bubbles must contrast strictly (e.g., user: bg-blue-50, AI: bg-slate-50).
components_strategy.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn components. Native HTML inputs are forbidden for complex elements (use Shadcn Select, Calendar). Labels must be left-aligned. Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none.
components_strategy.tables_and_lists: High-density data views. Use border-b on rows. Hover state: bg-slate-50. Use clear status pills (px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full) for VAT/Audit/AML statuses.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimalist micro-interactions. No bouncy or playful animations.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Explicitly set on all interactives. E.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High contrast ring for accessibility. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600

images.description: Minimalistic blue geometric abstract shape for authentication screens

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='vat-filing-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Never use gray-on-gray for essential compliance data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use TypeScript (.tsx), stick entirely to React JavaScript (.js) and JSX (.jsx).
Create the layout using pure HTML/Tailwind. Avoid overusing generic 'Card' wrappers if they restrict layout; use raw divs with the defined surface classes.

For the AI Compliance Assistant, build a chat interface that utilizes the 'Pastel & Soft' contrast rule internally (soft backgrounds with stark text) to differentiate it from the rigid compliance tables.
Implement navigation using a fixed left sidebar or a sticky top navigation with 'Crystal Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200).
Ensure all forms for corporate services and VAT use Shadcn multi-step logic with clear progress indicators.
When applying styles, rely on the color hex codes specified via standard Tailwind palette mappings (e.g., slate-900, blue-600) rather than inventing arbitrary custom colors.
